pokedexEntries.bk: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

pokedexEntries.wh: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It was revived from an ancient fossil. Not able to fly, it lived in treetops and hopped from one branch to another.

pokedexEntries.x: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.or: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.y: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

pokedexEntries.as: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

pokedexEntries.su: It is the ancestor of all bird Pokémon. Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.

pokedexEntries.mo: To all appearances flightless, it was able to glide down from tall treetops to snag its prey.

pokedexEntries.us: Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.

pokedexEntries.um: Restored from a fossil, this ancient bird Pokémon has wings but can’t yet fly.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it’s very good at jumping.

pokedexEntries.sh: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.
